source.title: 大学课程介绍和解说会, 2026年3月9日 (Kaplan Higher Education Academy)
source.fileNote: Kept local and in private storage only. Pages 66 (bank account details) and 87 (a named adviser's phone, WhatsApp and WeChat) contain payment and personal contact data and are not transcribed. Pages 57–58 show sample certificates and are not transcribed.
source.audience: Kaplan diploma students (international students on a Student's Pass) progressing to a partner bachelor's degree
source.validFor: Intakes from April 2026; application deadlines in March 2026 have passed as of 2026-10-18

notes: Verbatim quotes are copied from the deck's text layer (Chinese as in the deck, including its typos).

Except for UCD, each fee table's 总计金额 (total) does not equal the sum of its columns; the totals look like they already deduct the fee waiver, but the deck does not say so. Values are recorded as printed and flagged.

Page 49 says Portsmouth bridging is needed 以达到埃塞克斯大学学术要求 (to meet the University of Essex's academic requirements). This looks like a template error in the deck; it is flagged and not shown on the site.
Northumbria's Global Business Management (Human Resource) and (Logistics and Supply Chain) are struck through on pages 36, 40 and 41: not offered for this intake.
